shortDescription: Configures the BIG-IP DNS system to answer TCP or UDP DNS requests

options.name: address
options.description: Specifies the IP address on which the system listens.

options.name: advertise
options.description: Specifies whether this Listener's address is advertised to surrounding routers.

options.name: auto_lasthop
options.description: Specifies whether to automatically map the last hop for pools or not.

options.name: description
options.description: Provides a brief description for DNS Listener.

options.name: disabled_vlans
options.description: List of VLANs to be disabled. If the partition is not specified in the VLAN, then the C(partition) option of this module will be used. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the C(enabled_vlans) parameters.

options.name: enabled_vlans
options.description: List of VLANs to be enabled. When a VLAN named C(all) is used, all VLANs will be allowed. VLANs can be specified with or without the leading partition. If the partition is not specified in the VLAN, then the C(partition) option of this module will be used. This parameter is mutually exclusive with the C(disabled_vlans) parameter.

options.name: fallback_persistence
options.description: Specifies a fallback persistence profile for the Listener to use when the default persistence profile is not available.

options.name: ip_protocol
options.description: Specifies the protocol on which this Listener receives network traffic.

options.name: irules
options.description: Specifies list of iRules to run on the Listener. iRules help automate the intercepting, processing, and routing of application traffic. If you want to remove existing iRules, provide an empty list value; C([]). See the documentation for an example.

options.name: last_hop_pool
options.description: Specifies the name of the last hop pool that you want the Listener to use to direct reply traffic to the last hop router.

options.name: mask
options.description: Specifies the netmask for a network Listener only. Netmask clarifies whether the host bit is an actual zero or a wildcard representation.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the DNS Listener.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: pool
options.description: Specifies a default pool to which the Listener automatically directs traffic.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port on which the Listener listens for connections. Valid range of values is between C(0) and C(65535) inclusive.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: source_port
options.description: Specifies whether the system preserves the source port of the connection.

options.name: state
options.description: DNS Listener state. When C(present), ensures the pool is created and enabled. When C(absent), ensures the pool is removed from the system. When C(enabled) or C(disabled), ensures the pool is enabled or disabled respectively) on the remote device.

options.name: translate_address
options.description: Enables or disables address translation for the Listener.

options.name: translate_port
options.description: Enables or disables port translation.
